photos.alt: A long wooden bakery counter in front of shelves of fresh loaves, rolls and pastries, with round loaves mounted on small plaques along the wall above.
photos.colors: warm wood brown, soft grey wall, golden crust
photos.notes: Wide and calm. Round loaves on dark plaques run across the top, open shelves of loaves and pastries sit in the middle and a dark glass front fills the bottom edge, so put a dark-brown gradient on the left or bottom for text rather than relying on empty wall. Holds up at 16:9 and 21:9 when kept at 50% 60%.

photos.alt: Round scored sourdough loaves standing in brown paper bags in a big wooden basket lined with burlap, with more loaves on wooden shelves behind.
photos.colors: crust gold, kraft-paper brown, pale wood
photos.notes: Sharp, warm and tactile; the paper bags give it a corner-bakery feel. Works as a 4:3 card or a wide strip at 50% 60%. The top shelf row is soft background. No lettering.

photos.alt: Golden, flaky butter croissants piled in a black woven basket.
photos.notes: Sharp laminated layers, warm and natural. The black basket gives strong contrast on a cream page; a landscape crop works best.

photos.alt: A tall white buttercream layer cake with piped ruffles around the top and glossy red cherries on top, against a pale blue background.
photos.colors: cream white, cherry red, pale blue
photos.notes: Retro cherry-on-top look that matches the tomato-red palette. Pale blue negative space above the cake takes a label or stamp badge.

photos.alt: Chocolate and vanilla cupcakes with swirled frosting in paper cases on a rustic wooden board.
photos.notes: Classic bakery-counter cupcakes with a soft shallow depth of field; works at 4:3 and as a square.

photos.alt: Chocolate chip cookies on a parchment-lined baking tray, one broken open to show the melted chocolate inside.
photos.colors: golden tan, dark chocolate, warm grey
photos.notes: Portrait, top-down with a bitten-open cookie as the focal point; the pale grey tray suits a light card.

photos.alt: A lattice-topped fruit pie of dark cherries and diced apple dusted with powdered sugar on a white plate, with an apple just visible behind it.
photos.notes: Portrait, bright and clean; the red fruit echoes the tomato-red accent. Crop to the pie for a square.

photos.alt: A baker in a white jacket shapes a round of dough with flour-dusted hands on a floured wooden table.
photos.colors: flour white, pale wood, soft grey
photos.notes: Honest hands-at-work shot for the Rosa's story section; no faces, bright and airy. Landscape crops cleanly.

photos.alt: Tall wicker baskets stacked with crusty baguettes beside a burnt-orange wall and a marble counter in a bakery.
photos.colors: burnt orange, baguette gold, marble white
photos.notes: Portrait with a vintage shopfront feel; the orange wall sits close to the retro palette. Keep the crop on the upper two thirds.

photos.alt: Rows of iced donuts with chocolate sprinkles in pink, pistachio-green and chocolate glazes on a metal tray.
photos.notes: Saturated old-fashioned diner donuts, sharp and tightly framed; best as a wide strip or tile.

photos.alt: Low view through a glass bakery case at silver trays of powdered-sugar puff pastries, strawberry and berry tartlets and cream-filled buns.
photos.colors: golden pastry, strawberry red, steel silver
photos.notes: Old-world pastry case with no price tags or lettering anywhere in frame. The dark soft blur top-left takes a caption. Landscape; the sharpest pastries sit left of centre, so keep object-position at about 40% horizontally.

photos.alt: A three-tier white wedding cake ringed with red sugar roses and silver beading, with a cluster of roses on top, on a lace-covered table in a warmly lit banquet hall with blurred guests behind.
photos.colors: ivory white, rose red, warm banquet gold
photos.notes: Landscape, bright and clean, no cake-topper lettering. The red roses match the tomato-red palette. Guests and red chair bows are only soft blur in the background (no identifiable faces). Square crops at 58% 50% keep the whole cake.

photos.alt: Close-up of oat-topped loaves and floured round breads on a wooden bakery shelf, sharp in front and softly blurred behind.
photos.colors: toasted crust, oat gold, dark wood
photos.notes: Texture shot at 4:3 with a strong diagonal shelf edge; sharpest on the left. Good as a tile or a section background behind a dark overlay. No lettering.

photos.alt: Close-up of golden, flour-dusted loaves and rolls of bread piled together on a rustic cloth.
photos.notes: Texture and detail shot: warm crust close-up that works as a section background behind a dark overlay or as a tile.

photos.alt: Fresh crusty rolls tucked into brown paper bags on a wooden counter beside a vintage red-and-steel slicer.
photos.colors: slicer red, kraft-paper brown, crust gold
photos.notes: Old-school corner-shop mood: the red enamel slicer echoes the tomato-red palette and the kraft bags suit the paper-bag packaging look. No lettering. Landscape 3:2; keep the bags (right of centre) in frame.
